meta.name: The Leopard
meta.description: Amid the unification of 1860s Italy, a Sicilian prince grapples with the collision between his family's ancient privilege and revolutionary change.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: 1860: As an Italian army advances from the north to conquer Sicily, the Prince of Salina contends with his nephew's decision to fight for the enemy.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hoping to obtain a travel permit to Donnafugata, the Salinas attend Garibaldi's Liberation Ball, where Tancredi sees others vie for Concetta's affection.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tancredi's attraction to Angelica pulls him away from Concetta. Despite his distaste for Mayor Sedara, Don Fabrizio considers joint future prospects.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Concetta distances herself from her family, the Leopard entrusts more responsibilities to Paolo, whom Sedara informs of an enticing venture.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Still grieving, the Prince and Concetta travel to Turin, where a role in Italy's future awaits him. Tancredi and Angelica expose their ambitions.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Concetta makes her wish to leave Sicily clear, the Leopard silently endures health troubles. The Salinas attend the final ball of the season.
